name: Camping Mühlleiten
beschreibung: The Campingplatz Mühlleiten is located in Schönau am Königssee in the federal state of Tirol. The facility offers pitches for motorhomes and tents on a well-kept green area. The amenities include sanitary facilities with showers and WC, a bread roll service as well as a small shop for daily needs. In the surrounding area, marked hiking trails and cycling routes invite you to activities in the mountains. The nearby Königssee is suitable for boat trips and walks. The town of Berchtesgaden can be reached by car in a few minutes and offers cultural sights.
